user_saw: Clients uploading valid OpenAI-compatible requests over slow connections received HTTP 408 after 30 seconds, before inference began.
summary: The fix gives Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings requests 60 seconds to upload their bodies while retaining the shared 30-second default.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already had a 30-second total body-read deadline, and the shared compatibility endpoint helper inherited it by passing only the byte limit. The later refactors I checked preserved that deadline, and the available path history stopped at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify when the affected endpoints first inherited it or whether slow uploads had previously worked.
